annotations.title: Add error group to a request

description: Link an error group to a request, replacing the request it was linked to. The group's status then follows the request: when it ships, featury watches for the error on newer builds. Refused when the request's title, description or comments repeat a saved sample of the error. Calling it again with the same ids changes nothing. ENGINEER and above.

groupId.description: Error group id (uuid): list_error_groups returns these

ticketId.description: Ticket id (uuid): list_requests / get_request return these
